headings.strategy: Bold, clear, and highly legible even in harsh outdoor sunlight.

body.strategy: Functional, clinical, with a slightly larger base font size to support readability on small field devices.

colors.strategy: High-contrast clinical palette. Avoid Teal/Green (forbidden). Pure white backgrounds with 1px borders. No soft shadows. Avoid glassmorphism. Flat solid surfaces are mandatory for clinical clarity.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Stick to hard 1px borders (`border-slate-200`) instead of shadows to delineate cards. This ensures visibility under direct sunlight.
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Rounded-md or rounded-lg (4px to 8px max). Sharp but approachable.
visual_enhancers.spacing: Extremely generous padding. Minimum touch target for interactive elements must be 48px (`h-12` or `p-4`) for ease of use with one hand or gloves in the field.

layouts.navigation: Persistent bottom navigation bar on mobile containing: Dashboard, Patients, Sync, Admin. Top App bar containing Sync Status Indicator (Offline/Online chip).
layouts.scabies_wizard: Vertical scroll or step-by-step horizontal wizard. Must feature a fixed 'Sticky Footer' at the bottom with 'Previous' and 'Next' large tap buttons. Top should have a segmented progress indicator.
layouts.dashboard: Dense bento-grid on desktop, stacked single column on mobile. Cards should feature a single KPI with a small trend line or chart.

components_strategy.buttons: Rounded rectangle, `h-12` minimum height. Full-width on mobile. Use `data-testid` on all buttons.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI Form inputs. Height `h-12`. Must have visible borders and background colors that contrast with the page.
components_strategy.cards: Flat, 1px border. No drop shadows. High contrast text.
components_strategy.body_chart: Use an SVG-based interactive body map where users can tap regions. This is critical for Step 3 of the Scabies module.
components_strategy.offline_indicator: A permanent, glanceable chip in the header. Green for 'Synced', Yellow/Orange for 'Queued/Syncing', Red for 'Offline'.
components_strategy.clinical_alerts: Inline alert panels with sharp left border (e.g., `border-l-4 border-red-600 bg-red-50 text-red-900`) for URGENT warnings.

images.description: App Logo for login and header

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully clickable UI prototype using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI (.js). No backend required, use mock data and local state.
MANDATORY: Ensure tap targets are at least 48px high (e.g. `h-12`) for field usage.
MANDATORY: Do not use glassmorphism or transparent backgrounds on cards or headers. Use solid `#FFFFFF` or `#F8FAFC`.
MANDATORY: Implement a sticky footer for 'Next/Back' actions in the 9-step Scabies wizard.
MANDATORY: Create a mock interactive SVG Body Chart component for the Scabies assessment step.
Include a visible 'Sync Status' indicator in the top App Bar to demonstrate offline-first design.
Build the dashboard using Recharts for KPIs (e.g. treatment completion rate, cases by village).
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements.
universal_guidelines: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic by ensuring generous padding (`p-6`, `p-8`) and tight typography scaling.
Never center-align dense text or forms. Left-align for clinical readability.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Never use AI assistant emoji characters for icons.
